title: Rubric Feedback Bundles
user: Writing teachers with many short submissions who need to preserve meaningful, human feedback while avoiding repetitive retyping.
smallest_useful_product: Local-first browser tool to select reusable feedback fragments, tailor them per criterion, attach one short personal note, and export a readable student feedback page plus anonymized class misconception summary.
success_measure: A teacher completes feedback for 25 short pieces 30% faster while every student receives at least one specific personalized note.
constraints: Store student work locally unless the teacher explicitly exports; support accessible feedback pages; do not send submissions to an LLM.
